Question:
For a Canada-payroll employee considering a role-related conference, what is the annual learning-budget amount, and what conference registration limit and pre-purchase approval appear in Finance policy?

Retrieved context (grouped by document):
=== Document: HR-004 — Benefits Overview ===

[Section: Learning Budget]
Chunk ID: ada595ec-d4a0-412b-9dec-047fdbf68542
Score: 0.8208
Content:
Learning Budget

Employees receive an annual learning budget of 1,500 CAD or 1,100 USD for approved courses, books, conferences, and certifications related to their role. Manager approval is required before purchase.

Learning budget requests should include the business purpose and expected outcome. The learning budget is separate from required compliance training.

[Section: Wellness Stipend]
Chunk ID: 06d7e7e5-b2f6-4da6-b5f6-987b10266c52
Score: 0.5468
Content:
Wellness Stipend

Eligible full-time employees receive a wellness stipend of 750 CAD or 550 USD per calendar year, based on payroll country. The stipend may be used for fitness memberships, mental health apps, ergonomic equipment, or wellness programs.

Unused wellness stipend amounts do not carry over into the next calendar year.

[Section: Retirement Matching]
Chunk ID: b77cb8f4-3d7a-4c71-a2f6-39eefeb313d1
Score: 0.3925
Content:
Retirement Matching

Northstar offers retirement contribution matching after 3 months of service. The company match is up to 4% of eligible earnings, subject to payroll country rules and plan eligibility.

Exact compensation formulas and salary bands are not included in this benefits overview.

=== Document: FIN-001 — Expense, Procurement, and Reimbursement Policy ===

[Section: Expense Categories]
Chunk ID: 22e6e0ed-a681-4701-97d1-c1be7d69b0c0
Score: 0.5403
Content:
Expense Categories

| Category | Standard Limit | Approval Required |
| --- | ---: | --- |
| Meals during business travel | USD 85 per day | Manager approval above limit |
| Customer-facing meals | USD 125 per attendee | Manager approval and attendee list |
| Office supplies | USD 300 per purchase | Manager approval above limit |
| Software subscription trial | USD 500 annualized value | IT review and manager approval |
| Conference registration | USD 1,500 per event | Manager approval before purchase |

Alcohol is not reimbursable unless it is part of a customer-facing meal approved by a manager before the event. Gift cards, personal devices, fines, commuting costs, and family travel are not reimbursable.

[Section: Related Policies]
Chunk ID: ae3318d9-3093-40eb-bece-b2aa8ade381f
Score: 0.4906
Content:
Related Policies

Travel bookings must follow the Operations travel process. Vendor contracts must follow Legal approval rules. Software purchases must follow IT security review rules before reimbursement or procurement approval.

[Section: Policy Status]
Chunk ID: 83a57bc9-ac5f-411e-9684-7d80d72edf1f
Score: 0.4721
Content:
Policy Status

This policy is effective February 1, 2026 and replaces the 2025 informal spend guidance. If an older team wiki or email thread lists a different limit, this policy controls unless Finance publishes a newer version.

Employees should submit expenses within 30 calendar days of the transaction date. Expenses submitted after 60 calendar days require manager approval and a Finance Operations exception note.

=== Document: OPS-001 — Vendor, Travel, and Equipment Operations Policy ===

[Section: Overlap With Other Policies]
Chunk ID: 6e54582d-2f82-4e3b-a832-1117ce09a2e1
Score: 0.4679
Content:
Overlap With Other Policies

Expense reimbursement follows Finance policy. Contract signature follows Legal policy. Device configuration and data security follow IT security policy. When policies overlap, the stricter approval path applies.

[Section: Policy Scope]
Chunk ID: 5feea154-dae9-493a-b80d-a17187b6ab2b
Score: 0.3913
Content:
Policy Scope

This policy covers vendor onboarding, business travel booking, equipment requests, shipping, and operations exceptions. It applies to employees, managers, HR Admins, and IT Admins who request operational support.

Finance controls reimbursement and procurement thresholds. Legal controls contract review. IT controls device security. This Operations policy explains process ownership and routing.

=== Document: LEGAL-001 — Contract, NDA, and Data Retention Policy ===

[Section: Contract Approval Process]
Chunk ID: 56f368ca-8cf8-4eec-b828-67bb1302a583
Score: 0.3949
Content:
Contract Approval Process

| Contract Type | Legal Review | Finance Review | Final Approver |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Standard customer order form under USD 25,000 ARR | Optional unless redlines exist | Deal Desk | Sales Manager |
| Customer contract with security addendum | Required | Deal Desk | Sales Director |
| Vendor agreement under USD 10,000 | Required if data processing applies | Finance | Department Manager |
| Vendor agreement USD 10,000 or above | Required | Finance | Department Leader |
| Employment-related agreement | Required | HR Admin | People Leader |

No employee may sign a contract on behalf of Northstar unless they are listed in the signature authority register maintained by Legal Operations.

=== Document: HR-002 — PTO and Leave Policy ===

[Section: Missing Policy Areas]
Chunk ID: 50227ee4-84db-49ca-b46e-df7b730ecc0e
Score: 0.3809
Content:
Missing Policy Areas

Northstar does not publish a sabbatical policy in the employee knowledge base. Employees asking about sabbaticals should contact People Operations.
